title: AI Rubber Hose Animation Generator
summary: Make rubber hose animation with AI: bendy noodle limbs, white gloves and pie-cut eyes. Describe the gag, pick a style, and Flick draws it. Free to try.
body_markdown:
### What is rubber hose animation?


Rubber hose animation is a cartoon style from the late 1920s and early 1930s in which characters' arms and legs are drawn as smooth, bendy curves with no elbows or knees, usually with white gloves, pie-cut eyes and round bodies that bounce to music.


### Why is it called rubber hose?


The limbs are drawn as simple tubes that curve and flex like a garden hose instead of bending at joints, which made the characters fast to draw and easy to keep consistent across thousands of frames.


### Can AI make rubber hose animation?


Yes. Flick generates rubber hose style images from a text description and animates them into clips; name the noodle limbs, white gloves and pie-cut eyes, plus the black and white film grain, to get the 1930s look.


### What are pie-cut eyes?


Pie-cut eyes are black oval pupils with a small wedge cut out of them, like a slice taken from a pie, which gives a simple cartoon eye a highlight and a direction to look.


### Can I make rubber hose characters in colour?


Yes. Ask for an early two-colour film palette such as teal, coral and cream for a period look, or for flat saturated colour with thick clean outlines for the modern revival style.


### Is the rubber hose generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 and MiniMax H3 Fast both run on it.
